fullPassage: Every four years, a twenty-ninth day is added to the month of February. This day, also known as Leap Day, was created to ensure that our calendar and our seasons stay in line with each other. While we think that a normal year consists of 365 days, it actually takes Earth about 365.2421 days to orbit the sun. Every four years, it is necessary to add an extra day to account for the lost time. Without the addition of a leap day, winter would occur earlier in the calendar year, causing problems for agricultural schedules and potentially leading to crop failures. Additionally, many holidays and cultural celebrations are linked to specific seasons or dates. Without leap years to keep the calendar in check, these events would gradually drift away from their intended time of celebration.

det.korean: gradual(형용사: 점진적인) → gradually(부사: 점차). 동사 drift를 수식하는 부사
det.analysis: 형용사 gradual을 부사 gradually로 변환. 동사 drift(벗어나다)를 수식하려면 부사 형태가 필요하다. '점차 벗어나다'
det.tip: 동사(drift) 수식 → 부사 -ly → gradually

questions.passage: Every four years, a twenty-ninth day is added to the month of February. This day, also known as Leap Day, was created to ensure that our calendar and our seasons stay in line with each other. While we think that a normal year consists of 365 days, it actually takes Earth about 365.2421 days to orbit the sun. Every four years, it is necessary to add __________ to account for the lost time. Without the addition of a leap day, winter would occur earlier in the calendar year, causing problems for agricultural schedules and potentially leading to crop failures. Additionally, many holidays and cultural celebrations are linked to specific seasons or dates. Without leap years to keep the calendar in check, these events would gradually drift away from their intended time of celebration.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: a whole month=한 달 전체 / an extra day=하루 더 / a leap week=윤주 / a lost hour=잃어버린 한 시간
det.analysis:
① a whole month: 한 달을 더한다? 과함
② an extra day: 4년마다 잃어버린 시간을 보충하려 '하루를 더' 추가 ←정답
③ a leap week: 윤주? 본문에 없는 개념
④ a lost hour: 한 시간? 29번째 날(하루) 단위가 맞음
det.tip: add ___ to account for the lost time, 29번째 날 → an extra day(하루 더)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: modern digital devices=현대 디지털 기기 / random winter storms=무작위 겨울 폭풍 / specific seasons or dates=특정 계절이나 날짜 / ancient farming tools=고대 농기구
det.analysis:
① modern digital devices: 기념행사가 디지털 기기와 연결? 부적절
② random winter storms: 겨울 폭풍? 부적절
③ specific seasons or dates: 명절·기념행사는 '특정 계절이나 날짜'와 연결됨 ←정답
④ ancient farming tools: 농기구? 부적절
det.tip: holidays and celebrations are linked to ___ → specific seasons or dates(특정 계절·날짜)
